en.askTitle: Put in your own dates, driving limit and budget to get a South Island plan with every price dated
en.runTitle: Sydney couple, 6–13 March 2027: a South Island road trip on about NZD 4,500, with Milford Sound and Mount Cook

fields.label: Dates and travellers
fields.value: A couple travelling from Sydney, Saturday 6 March to Saturday 13 March 2027 (7 days)

fields.label: Arrival airport and time
fields.value: Flying into Queenstown on Saturday 6 March 2027

fields.label: Departure airport and time
fields.value: Flying out of Christchurch on Saturday 13 March 2027

fields.label: Budget excluding or including flights
fields.value: About NZD 4,500 for two, excluding international flights

fields.label: Licences and ages
fields.placeholder: e.g. both hold full Australian licences, aged 35 and 37

fields.label: Personal-driving or total-road-time limit
fields.value: No more than 4 hours of driving on any day

en.template: Plan a South Island trip for {dates}, arriving at {arrive} and leaving from {leave}, with {budget}, {passport}, {licence}, {walking} and {limit}. Separate dated prices from estimates, compare final room/car totals, and include weather alternatives. Plan only; do not book or pay.

phases.title: Check the route, places to stay, car hire, walks and entry rules against current sources
phases.note: Milford Sound road and cruises, car rental terms, official walking track pages, entry rules for Australians
phases.judgment: It kept advertising from passing as a quote. One rental firm’s “from $19.99 a day” is a general ad, not a March price, and no date-specific car or room quote was claimed. The gaps are labelled next to the costs.

phases.title: Build the itinerary and the dated source list, with a budget that adds up
phases.note: Seven nights allocated, 12 places to stay priced, car options compared

phases.title: Check the files, the arithmetic and the final delivery
phases.judgment: The independent check recalculated the budget ($4,285 planned plus $215 contingency makes $4,500) and then said plainly what arithmetic cannot prove: it is still unverified that the trip can actually be booked within NZD 4,500, because no dated room or car totals exist yet. The guide already says so.

workers: Found publicly priced places to stay, two for each of the six stops, with the price and the date it was seen
Checked two car rental firms’ published prices, one-way fees and insurance excess, plus entry rules for Australians and the current fuel price
Independently audited the finished guide: dates, nights covered, budget arithmetic and spot checks against the original sources

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的日期、驾驶上限和预算，就能得到每个价格都带日期的南岛行程
zh.runTitle: 悉尼夫妻，2027 年 3 月 6 日至 13 日：新西兰南岛自驾，预算约 4,500 新西兰元，含米尔福德峡湾和库克山

fields.label: 日期和人数
fields.value: 从悉尼出发的一对夫妻，2027 年 3 月 6 日（周六）至 3 月 13 日（周六），共 7 天

fields.label: 机场及抵达时间
fields.value: 2027 年 3 月 6 日飞抵皇后镇

fields.label: 机场及离开时间
fields.value: 2027 年 3 月 13 日从基督城飞走

fields.label: 含不含机票及金额
fields.value: 约 4,500 新西兰元（两人），不含国际机票

fields.label: 驾照及年龄
fields.placeholder: 例如：两人都持澳洲正式驾照，分别 35 岁和 37 岁

fields.label: 步行需求
fields.value: 轻松到中等强度的步行

fields.label: 个人驾驶或全部公路时间上限
fields.value: 每天开车不超过 4 小时

zh.template: 请规划{dates}的新西兰南岛行程，从{arrive}入境、{leave}离境，预算{budget}，护照和澳洲签证身份{passport}，驾照及年龄{licence}，步行需求{walking}，上限是{limit}。分清有日期的价格和估算，比较住宿及租车最终总价，并给天气备选。只做计划，不预订、不付款。

phases.title: 对照最新资料核实路线、住宿、租车、步道和入境规定
phases.note: 米尔福德峡湾公路与游船、租车条款、官方步道页面、澳洲旅客入境规定
phases.judgment: 它没有让广告冒充报价：某租车公司的“每天 19.99 起”只是泛泛广告，不是 3 月的价格，所以没有声称拿到任何带日期的租车或房价；这些缺口都标在对应费用旁边。

phases.title: 搭建行程和带日期的来源清单，预算要合得上
phases.note: 七晚住宿全部安排，12 处住宿已标价，租车方案已比较

phases.title: 检查文件、计算和最终交付
phases.judgment: 独立复核重算了预算（计划 4,285 加备用 215，合计 4,500 新西兰元），并明说算术证明不了的事：因为还没有带日期的房价和租车总价，这趟能否真的在 4,500 新西兰元内订下，仍未核实。指南里已写明这一点。

workers: 为六个落脚点各找两处公开标价的住宿，记下价格和查到的日期
核对两家租车公司公布的价格、异地还车费和保险自付额，以及澳洲旅客入境规定和当前油价
独立审查成品指南：日期、夜数、预算计算，并对照原始来源抽查
